title: (Patched - New Vid on Channel) 13 Min Full Kuldra Run – Follow Along | RuneScape Dragonwilds
author: SamFPlays
chapters: Shortcut + windstep to Garou Thane (kill with melee)
Pylon order: air, water, earth, fire
Final area windsteps to Kuldra's heart
description:
⚠️ PATCHED: some skips in this run no longer work. NEW post-patch 1.0.1 run (11 min) here 👉 https://youtu.be/WpvNjqVmpVM

⚡ NEW: Sub 10 min run with faster skips 👉 https://youtu.be/iu2SL4oyZFQ


13 minute full Kuldra run in RuneScape: Dragonwilds, post-patch. Follow along from start to kill with every shortcut and windstep skip. Use the chapters below to jump to the part you're stuck on.

GEAR & SETUP
- Fleet Foot Infusion: MUST BRING. Cuts sprinting stamina cost by 50%.
- Strong Tea: nice to have, restores +20 Rest.
- Mage weapon: 2-handed mage staff for killing the heart at the end.
- Melee weapon: best crush weapon you have, for Garou Thane.
- Armour: best melee and mage gear you have.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Start
0:20 Windstep shortcut
0:42 Anima pylon double jump dash
1:12 Soulscourge tank
1:28 Confuse archer + dodge black dragon
1:48 Windstep past necromancer phase
2:12 Garou windstep
2:44 Poison rat area skip (2 windsteps)
3:20 Waterfall area skip
3:50 Abyssal demon
4:25 Hard garou section
4:35 Shortcut + windstep to Garou Thane (kill with melee)
5:15 Secret passageway to fire anima
5:42 Fire anima vs garou
6:18 Black dragon area
6:45 Parkour section
7:33 Vault guardian sentinel
7:50 Pipe shortcut
8:25 Path to fire pylon
9:19 Pylon order: air, water, earth, fire
10:15 Final area windsteps to Kuldra's heart
11:20 Kuldra kill

KEY TIPS
- Abyssal demon (3:50): sometimes he follows you all the way up. If he does, just kill him.
- Garou Thane (4:35): kill him for an air charge to activate the dispenser. Use melee. I killed him with mage before and didn't get the charge.
- Fire anima (5:42): put the anima between you and the garou.
- Vault guardian (7:33): confuse/kill the sentinel and hug the right side so the 2 on the left don't wake up.
- Fire pylon (8:25): stand at the edge of the circle so the sentinels don't wake up.
- Pylon puzzle (9:19): if you accidentally stepped on any of the platforms while running earlier, step on all of them to reset, then do air, water, earth, fire.
- Kuldra's heart (11:20): stop right before the rib cage on the left side so no heartworms spawn near you. Left click and enjoy!

Questions about the route? Drop them in the comments and I'll answer.

#Dragonwilds #RuneScape #Kuldra

comments.text: There's a faster skip after the Garou Thane. In the back corner there is a hole you can jump to and crouch through. A couple of jumps from here and you're at the abby demon. I think you can get close to 10 min runs with all those skips.
